documents.beforeNote: DFA PRC-1 referral and program documentation form. This student referral document is relevant when a student asks about public assistance paperwork, program records, TANF or WV Works documentation, or caseworker-required forms.
documents.afterNote: Personal Responsibility Contract and Initial Self-Sufficiency Plan, DFA-PRC-1 revision January 2024. Covers WV WORKS/TANF participant and agency responsibilities. Records an initial primary goal, short-term goals, target dates, barriers, support services, activity deadlines, and signatures. Use for agreeing to responsibilities and starting a self-sufficiency plan. This is not a program-completion or referral record.

documents.beforeNote: The master onboarding checklist that lists every step, form, and topic an instructor must complete with a new student during orientation before they begin class. When preparing for or conducting a new student's orientation — this is the master reference that ensures every required form, policy acknowledgment, and program introduction is covered.
documents.afterNote: Master checklist for a new student starting SPOKES class: first-day paperwork, registration forms, and policies to complete, read, or sign. Includes the student profile, attendance contract, rights and responsibilities, dress code, information release, media release, technology acceptable use, participant timesheet, and education/career planning. Also lists instructor orientation, screening, and assessment tasks. Retrieval aliases: getting started in class; new-student intake; papers to sign; first-day forms.

documents.beforeNote: Master checklist for building your employment portfolio with resume, certifications, and work samples When a student (or instructor) needs to track progress toward completing the employment portfolio — checking off items such as resume, certifications, and work samples as they are completed over time. — Requirements for completing your Employment Portfolio During orientation, when a student needs to understand what is required to complete their employment portfolio — the full list of what they will need to collect and build.
documents.afterNote: Employment portfolio checklist: what belongs in a work folder or job portfolio. Lists a resume, cover letter, references, diploma or equivalency credential, certificates, letters of reference, completed master application, computer-skills samples in Excel/PowerPoint/Word, and professional or creative writing samples. Tracks each item and its completion date. Retrieval aliases: work folder; job folder; portfolio contents; work samples; papers to collect for employment.

documents.sourceKey: students/resources/SPOKES Life and Employability Module Rubric Record.pdf
documents.beforeNote: Rubric record for the SPOKES Life and Employability Skills modules — the "-2" revision that supersedes the prior RAG copy (Phase A Q8 refresh). When scoring or explaining Life and Employability Skills module completion against the official rubric. This staged file is the **"-2" revision** (722,000 B) uploaded under the existing live storage key name (no `-2` suffix) to refresh the bucket object (Phase A Q8).
documents.afterNote: SPOKES Life and Employability Module Rubric Record, revised April 2024. Records module dates and scores for critical thinking, personal qualities, interpersonal skills, resource management, communication, and information use. Includes goal setting, job search, employment portfolio, and interviews. Certificate fields record whether required module rubrics reached 80%. Use for module scoring and completion progress; use the Employment Portfolio Checklist for the required contents of a work folder.
